boss.jp: I have a part-time job interview tomorrow.
boss.zh: 明天有打工的面試。

boss.jp: I cut my hair short.
boss.zh: 我把頭髮剪短了。

boss.jp: I got the nuts from the tree with a long stick.
boss.zh: 我用長棍子打下了樹上的果實。

boss.jp: I've almost finished my homework.
boss.zh: 作業差不多寫完了。

boss.jp: I heard there's an author's signing event at the bookstore.
boss.zh: 聽說書店有作家的簽名會。

boss.jp: The school is discussing how to end bullying.
boss.ko: 학교는 괴롭힘을 없애기 위해 논의하고 있다.
boss.zh: 學校正在討論如何消除霸凌。

boss.jp: Please answer the survey.
boss.zh: 請回答問卷。

boss.jp: Kanji have on-readings and kun-readings.
boss.zh: 漢字有音讀和訓讀。

boss.jp: I thought about lots of things, but in the end I stayed home.
boss.zh: 想了很多，結果還是待在家裡。

boss.jp: In the future, I want to become a politician and improve my town.
boss.ko: 장래에 정치가가 되어 마을을 좋게 만들고 싶다.
boss.zh: 將來我想當政治家，讓城鎮變得更好。

boss.jp: Let's hold off on games until homework is done.
boss.zh: 在寫完作業之前先忍住不玩遊戲吧。

boss.jp: I succeeded at making a cake for the first time!
boss.zh: 我第一次成功做出蛋糕了！

boss.jp: Even when I get old, I want to walk around with energy.
boss.zh: 就算上了年紀，我也想健康地走路。

boss.jp: He's been my friend since childhood.
boss.zh: 他是我從小到大的朋友。

boss.jp: My dad likes watching professional baseball games.
boss.ko: 아빠는 프로야구 경기 보는 걸 좋아한다.
boss.zh: 我爸爸喜歡看職棒比賽。

boss.jp: The new system is easy to use, isn't it?
boss.zh: 新系統很好用呢。

boss.jp: I'm going back to my parents' home over the long weekend.
boss.zh: 連假我要回老家。

boss.jp: I finally got the book I wanted!
boss.ko: 드디어 갖고 싶던 책을 손에 넣었다!
boss.zh: 終於拿到我想要的書了！

boss.jp: I love this town from the bottom of my heart.
boss.zh: 我打從心底愛著這座城鎮。

boss.jp: I checked my hair in the mirror before going out.
boss.zh: 出門前我照鏡子檢查了頭髮。

boss.jp: This study method is very effective.
boss.zh: 這個讀書方法非常有效。

boss.jp: I threw paper in rock-paper-scissors.
boss.zh: 猜拳時我出了布。

boss.jp: At last, I opened the shop I'd dreamed of.
boss.zh: 終於開了夢想中的店。

boss.jp: This task will take about an hour.
boss.ko: 이 작업은 한 시간 정도면 끝나.
boss.zh: 這項作業大概一個小時就能完成。
words: 一時間ぐらいで終わるよ。

boss.jp: My phone screen cracked.
boss.zh: 我的手機螢幕裂了。

boss.jp: The two raised their hands at the same time.
boss.ko: 두 사람이 손을 든 건 동시였다.
boss.zh: 兩個人是同時舉手的。

boss.jp: I stayed one night at a friend's house.
boss.zh: 我在朋友家住了一晚。

boss.jp: Grandpa told us about his old memories.
boss.zh: 爺爺跟我們講了以前的回憶。

boss.jp: This picture seems to have been drawn by a child.
boss.ko: 이 그림은 아이가 그린 것으로 보인다.
boss.zh: 這幅畫似乎是小孩畫的。

boss.jp: This is my favorite café.
boss.zh: 這是我最喜歡的咖啡廳。

boss.jp: My brother goes to a national university.
boss.zh: 我哥哥在讀國立大學。

boss.jp: My neck hurts, so I changed my pillow.
boss.zh: 因為脖子痛，我換了枕頭。

boss.jp: We talked about children's education.
boss.zh: 我們討論了孩子的教育問題。

boss.jp: I like clothes in plain colors.
boss.zh: 我喜歡顏色樸素的衣服。

boss.jp: A reporter is interviewing an athlete.
boss.zh: 記者正在採訪選手。

boss.jp: I was happy to hear my brother got engaged.
boss.zh: 聽說哥哥訂婚了，我很開心。

boss.jp: The athlete gave an interview after the game.
boss.zh: 選手在比賽後接受了採訪。

boss.jp: Dozens of people were standing in line.
boss.ko: 수십 명이나 되는 사람들이 줄을 서 있었어요.
boss.zh: 有好幾十個人在排隊。

boss.jp: Put the leftover food in the fridge as it is.
boss.ko: 남은 요리는 그대로 냉장고에 넣어 줘.
boss.zh: 剩下的菜就直接放進冰箱吧。

boss.jp: Let's take a photo with the blue sky in the background.
boss.zh: 以藍天為背景拍張照吧。

boss.jp: We made a short film for the school festival.
boss.ko: 학교 축제를 위해 짧은 영화를 제작했다.
boss.zh: 為了校慶，我們製作了一部短片。

boss.jp: The view from the top of the mountain was splendid.
boss.zh: 從山頂看到的景色非常壯觀。

boss.jp: Medicine advances every year.
boss.zh: 醫學每年都在進步。

boss.jp: I've been sleepy lately from lack of sleep.
boss.zh: 最近睡眠不足很睏。

boss.jp: Please see the official website for details.
boss.ko: 자세한 내용은 공식 사이트를 봐 주세요.
boss.zh: 詳細內容請參考官方網站。

boss.jp: I caught a cold, so I'm wearing a mask.
boss.zh: 我感冒了，所以戴著口罩。

boss.jp: My older sister often reads fashion magazines.
boss.zh: 我姊姊常看時尚雜誌。

boss.jp: I played a card game with my friends during the break.
boss.ko: 쉬는 시간에 친구들과 카드 게임을 했다.
boss.zh: 下課時間我和朋友玩了卡牌遊戲。

boss.jp: I wonder what towns will be like in the future.
boss.zh: 未來的城鎮會變成什麼樣子呢？

boss.jp: Before a match, I focus my mind.
boss.zh: 比賽前要集中精神。

boss.jp: Let's try to find the differences between the two pictures.
boss.zh: 我們來找找這兩幅畫的不同之處吧。

boss.jp: There's an oddly shaped building in front of the station.
boss.ko: 역 앞에 특이한 모양의 건물이 있다.
boss.zh: 車站前有一棟形狀奇特的建築。

boss.ko: 유이는 항상 웃는 얼굴로 인사해 준다.
boss.zh: 結衣總是笑著跟我打招呼。

boss.zh: 襯衫上的污漬怎麼洗都洗不掉。

boss.jp: About half the class are girls.
boss.zh: 班上女生的比例大約一半。

boss.jp: I gave my mother a gift on Mother's Day.
boss.zh: 母親節我送了禮物給媽媽。

boss.jp: It suddenly started raining.
boss.zh: 突然下起雨來了。

boss.zh: 市民會館有一場音樂會。

boss.jp: On rainy days I play video games at home with my brother.

boss.a: 姉はいつもおしゃれなスタイルをしている。
